answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents leverages unique, cryptographically bound resource ownership. Each agent requires a significant, non-fungible stake in a scarce computational resource, like a unique data processing *inlet*. An attacker faces an insurmountable economic *horizon* to acquire enough distinct resources to launch a large-scale attack. Any attempt to *whisper* new, unstaked identities into the network is instantly identifiable, ensuring attacks are prohibitively costly by design.
